title: PhantomBonk
description: Removes Phantoms with customizeable SpawnReason Check.
body:
![Slogan](https://i.imgur.com/KwxOCnO.png) ## ⚡ Features - 🚫 **Selective Phantom Control** — block phantom spawns by exact cause (`NATURAL`, `SPAWNER`, `SPAWNER_EGG`, `COMMAND`, `CUSTOM`) instead of one all-or-nothing toggle - 🌍 **Per-World Rules** — override individual spawn causes for specific worlds, or exempt entire worlds completely - 🔁 **Live Reload** — `/phantombonk reload` applies config changes instantly, no restart needed - 🪶 **Lightweight** — one event listener, zero measurable performance impact - 🔌 **Sensible Defaults** — blocks natural phantom spawns out of the box, fully configurable from there - 🛡️ **Permission-Gated** — reload command locked behind `phantombonk.reload` --- ## 🛠️ Installation 1. Download the `phantombonk-VERSION.jar` file 2. Place it into your server's `/plugins` folder 3. Restart your server 4. Done — phantoms now follow your rules ✅ --- ## 🔧 Compatibility | Minecraft Version | Supported | |:-----------------:|:---------:| | 26.2 | ✅ | | 26.1 | ✅ | | 1.21.11 | ✅ | | 1.21.10 | ✅ | | 1.21.9 | ✅ | | 1.21.8 | ✅ | | 1.21.7 | ✅ | | 1.21.6 | ✅ | > **Server Software:** Spigot/PaperMC and Forks --- ## 💬 Support & Feedback Found a bug or have a suggestion? Open an issue on GitHub — feedback is always welcome! ---
